published_concept: At least one hydrophobic residue contacts C18 in the discussed antibody complexes

production_rule.distance_policy: Native DS classification only; actual atom distances are diagnostics
production_rule.hydrogen_policy: Explicit hydrogens required for comparable DS methyl typing; no H ensemble calibration

coordinate_mapping: Reference C18 bonded to C13; production E2L file C10 bonded to C16
reference_preparation: DS AddHydrogenAtoms(allHydrogenAtoms,True); all heavy identities and coordinates unchanged; monitor AddHydrogens=False
native_distance_warning: DS group distances are not substituted for C18-to-protein-atom distances
limitations: Concept-informed native DS presence, not a published DS numerical cutoff
Positive-reference calibration and synthetic deletion controls, not independently validated selectivity or affinity prediction
Copies of one crystal system are not independent families
DS does not reproduce every paper-named contact (e.g. HSD1 Val143 and 17E12E5 Glu99)
Requiring the training-set minimum count fails held-out 17E12E5; one partner is the paper-informed operational choice
Does not measure SASA, percentage burial or E2-versus-E3 discrimination
